items.pergunta: How far in advance do I need to book?
items.resposta: At least 6 hours ahead. Booking the day before is ideal to guarantee your preferred time slot.

items.pergunta: Is the quoted estimate the final price?
items.resposta: It is very close to the final fare. Gil confirms the exact price on WhatsApp prior to your trip. If the route or duration changes on the day, the fare is adjusted accordingly.

items.pergunta: Does the driver wait during my appointment?
items.resposta: Yes. In Round Trip with Wait Time and Senior Care Rides, your chauffeur stays at your disposal for the agreed period.

items.pergunta: Can I book a ride for someone else?
items.resposta: Yes. Many children and grandchildren book for parents and grandparents. Just include the passenger's name and phone number.

items.pergunta: Do you travel outside Greater Vitória?
items.resposta: Yes, under Day Trips & Travel to destinations like Domingos Martins, Pedra Azul and coastal towns. Overnight trips are quoted individually on WhatsApp.

items.pergunta: May I bring my own drinks?
items.resposta: Yes. An iced cooler is available on board for passengers.
Payment is arranged upon booking confirmation: Pix, credit or debit card, or cash.
